one_line: The paper applies the ISO 50001 energy-planning stage to a hotel (Hotel Punta la Cueva, Cuba), a service-sector accommodation facility, to build an energy baseline and performance indicator; the only Corpus-B-adjacent content is cement- and steel-industry studies cited in the references/comparison table.
